feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible attack on Iran after the midterms
entry.summary: The U.S. and Israel are making moves that point to the possibility of renewed heavy fighting in Iran. The prospect of military escalation is complicated by critical elections in both the U.S. and Israel in the coming days.

entry.title: Retired general discusses the U.S. and Israeli plan for possible attack on Iran
entry.summary: NPR'S Leila Fadel speaks with retired four-star Gen. Joseph Votel about the war in Iran and the U.S. and Israeli objectives for a potential post-election bombing campaign.

entry.title: Trump's midterm campaign tour stops in Iowa
entry.summary: Republicans are facing a tough fight in Iowa. President Trump's campaign tour stopped in the state in hopes of rallying voters.

entry.title: With jet fuel prices near a record, holiday airfares soar higher
entry.summary: If you're planning to fly this holiday season, be prepared to pay more than you did last year. The price of jet fuel — one of airlines' biggest expenses — is close to an all-time high in the U.S.

entry.title: Brazil's runoff: Lula's legacy vs. Bolsonaro's dynasty
entry.summary: Brazil's tight presidential runoff pits a political giant against a Bolsonaro heir in a battle over the country's political future.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible attack on Iran, millions of Americans have voted early, judge orders President Trump to sit for deposition in BBC lawsuit.

entry.title: Sacha Baron Cohen's Ali G returns to the big screen in 'Ali G: Who Iz I?'
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez talks to comedic actor Sacha Baron Cohen, who has revived his character Ali G, the clueless celebrity interviewer, for a new movie, "Ali G: Who Iz I?"

entry.title: Advocates fight for expanded lung cancer screening guidelines
entry.summary: Health advocates argue that lung cancer screening guidelines should expand beyond smoking history to factor in risks like family history and radon exposure.

entry.title: Tech stocks dropped sharply. What it means for the rest of the economy
entry.summary: Tech stocks dropped sharply Wednesday, NPR's Leila Fadel asks David Wessel of the Brookings Institution what it means.

entry.title: Former deputy national security adviser discusses Netanyahu's reelection campaign
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel asks former Deputy National Security Adviser Jon Finer what a seventh term in office for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu would mean for the U.S. and Israel.
